 lifestyle Gyu-Kaku closes last outlet at CHIJMES, exiting Singapore market after two decades
 The Japanese BBQ chain is set to close its CHIJMES outlet after Nov 15. PHOTO: Google Maps PUBLISHED ON November 03, 2026 9:18 AM BY Carol Ong Thinking of heading down to Gyu-Kaku for some yakiniku (grilled meat)? 
 You might want to visit soon, as the Japanese BBQ chain is set to close its CHIJMES outlet after Nov 15.
 "To all our valued customers, thank you for being part of our journey. Your continued patronage, loyalty and support over the years have made every moment truly special," Gyu-Kaku announced on Tuesday (Nov 3). 
 The closure of the CHIJMES outlet — which has been operating for over two decades — will mark its exit from Singapore.
 [embed]https://www.instagram.com/p/DfQ0UtSTQdA/[/embed]
 This year, the Japanese BBQ chain has shuttered several outlets here, including Vivocity, Kinex, The Star Vista and Waterway Point.
 In 2025, Gyu-Kaku shut down branches at UE Square, Novena Square and The Centrepoint.
 [embed]https://www.instagram.com/p/DL4gVkfvU3i/[/embed]
 Founded in 1996, Gyu-Kaku is a Japanese restaurant chain specialising in yakiniku . 
 It operates over 700 outlets in Japan, as well as multiple overseas locations including Singapore, Hong Kong, Taipei, Indonesia and the US. 
 AsiaOne has reached out to Gyu-Kaku for more information. 
 Address: 30 Victoria Street, #01-01 CHIJMES, Singapore 187996 
 Opening hours: 12pm to 3pm, 5.30pm to 10pm (Monday to Friday), 12pm to 10pm (Saturday and Sunday)
